title: Initialize @rathkit/nx-plugin
description: Registers the plugin in nx.json, adds @rathkit/pack to the dev dependencies, and opts projects in with a rathkit.config.mjs.

project.description: Projects to build with rkp (a rathkit.config.mjs is created in each). Default: every project with an index.html or a src/main or src/index file that has no build target yet.

packVersion.description: The version or tag of @rathkit/pack to add.

keepExistingVersions.description: Keep the version of @rathkit/pack if package.json already has one.

skipFormat.description: Do not format the files that change.
